title: Genetic Testing
description: An add-on mod for the Genetic Animals mod that allows you to perform genetic tests on your animals
body:
An add-on mod for the Genetic Animals mod that allows you to use a vanilla book to receive a record of the various genes the animal possesses, similar to genetic tests you would see in mods like Realistic Horse Genetics or Simply Cats.

This is an optional tool for people - while it won't be present in the main mod you are free to use this in your singleplayer worlds or even your servers. Please keep in mind it will only work on servers if it is present on both the client and server.

Please check the [wiki](https://github.com/Maltshakes/GeneticTesting/wiki) for more detailed information on the individual genes per animal.

Planned Features:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- [Genetic Bettas](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/genetic-bettas) gene testing support (currently in V1.0+).
- Color genes testing module (currently in V1.0+).
- Body proportion genes testing module.
- Production genes testing module.
- Config options to enable/disable which testing modules you want active, server config takes priority.
- Config options to enable filters, which will be disabled by default, such as a phenotype filter where the gene book will only tell you what gene is expressed for each gene locus to add back a bit of challenge. As before, server config takes priority.

</details>



Not Planned:

<details>
<summary>Spoiler</summary>

- Pedigrees - animals do not store enough data for me to pull entire family trees.
- Breed certification - breeds are just animals that spawn with narrower gene ranges, there is nothing in an animal's data that says what breed it is, even when spawned in a village pen or brought by the wandering trader. While I could check to see if an animal's genes falls within an allowed range, that has the risk of throwing false positives which would make such a tool worthless.

</details>



I create datapacks, resource packs, scripts and mods that add compat between GA and other mods. If you find this mod useful, please let me know or even give me a tip on [Ko-FI](https://ko-fi.com/maltshakes). It shows me that tools like this are appreciated and motivates me to make more!
